ar: اوليك جزاوهم ان عليهم لعنة ٱلله وٱلمليكة وٱلناس اجمعين
tgt: They are those whose recompense is that on them (rests) the Curse of Allah, of the angels, and of all mankind
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: ولقد جاءكم موسى بٱلبينت ثم ٱتخذتم ٱلعجل من بعده وانتم ظلمون
tgt: And indeed Musa (Moses) came to you with clear proofs, yet you worshipped the calf after he left, and you were Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: ولين مستهم نفحة من عذاب ربك ليقولن يويلنا انا كنا ظلمين
tgt: And if a breath (minor calamity) of the Torment of your Lord touches them, they will surely cry: "Woe unto us! Indeed we have been Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: واذ قال موسى لقومه يقوم انكم ظلمتم انفسكم بٱتخاذكم ٱلعجل فتوبوا الى باريكم فٱقتلوا انفسكم ذلكم خير لكم عند باريكم فتاب عليكم انه هو ٱلتواب ٱلرحيم
tgt: And (remember) when Musa (Moses) said to his people: "O my people! Verily, you have wronged yourselves by worshipping the calf. So turn in repentance to your Creator and kill yourselves (the innocent kill the wrongdoers among you), that will be better for you with your Lord." Then He accepted your repentance. Truly, He is the One Who accepts repentance, the Most Merciful
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وتلك حجتنا ءاتينها ابرهيم على قومه نرفع درجت من نشاء ان ربك حكيم عليم‏
tgt: And that was Our Proof which We gave Ibrahim (Abraham) against his people. We raise whom We will in degrees. Certainly your Lord is All-Wise, All-Knowing
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وٱتقوا ٱلنار ٱلتي اعدت للكفرين
tgt: And fear the Fire, which is prepared for the disbelievers
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: ودخل ٱلمدينة على حين غفلة من اهلها فوجد فيها رجلين يقتتلان هذا من شيعته وهذا من عدوه فٱستغثه ٱلذي من شيعته على ٱلذي من عدوه فوكزه موسى فقضى عليه قال هذا من عمل ٱلشيطن انه عدو مضل مبين‏
tgt: And he entered the city at a time of unawareness of its people, and he found there two men fighting, - one of his party (his religion - from the Children of Israel), and the other of his foes. The man of his (own) party asked him for help against his foe, so Musa (Moses) struck him with his fist and killed him. He said: "This is of Shaitan's (Satan) doing, verily, he is a plain misleading enemy
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: كتب عليكم اذا حضر احدكم ٱلموت ان ترك خيرا ٱلوصية للولدين وٱلاقربين بٱلمعروف حقا على ٱلمتقين
tgt: It is prescribed for you, when death approaches any of you, if he leaves wealth, that he make a bequest to parents and next of kin, according to reasonable manners. (This is) a duty upon Al-Muttaqun (the pious - see V)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: اوليك ٱلذين ليس لهم في ٱلاخرة الا ٱلنار وحبط ما صنعوا فيها وبطل ما كانوا يعملون
tgt: They are those for whom there is nothing in the Hereafter but Fire; and vain are the deeds they did therein. And of no effect is that which they used to do
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: يطاف عليهم بصحاف من ذهب واكواب وفيها ما تشتهيه ٱلانفس وتلذ ٱلاعين وانتم فيها خلدون
tgt: Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them, (there will be) therein all that the one's inner-selves could desire, all that the eyes could delight in, and you will abide therein forever
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: قال ٱلذين ٱستكبروا انا بٱلذي ءامنتم به كفرون
tgt: Those who were arrogant said: "Verily, we disbelieve in that which you believe in
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: قل اونبيكم بخير من ذلكم للذين ٱتقوا عند ربهم جنت تجري من تحتها ٱلانهر خلدين فيها وازوج مطهرة ورضون من ٱلله وٱلله بصير بٱلعباد
tgt: Say: "Shall I inform you of things far better than those? For Al-Muttaqun (the pious - see V. 2:2) there are Gardens (Paradise) with their Lord, underneath which rivers flow. Therein (is their) eternal (home) and Azwajun Mutahharatun (purified mates or wives) [i.e. they will have no menses, urine, or stool, etc.], And Allah will be pleased with them. And Allah is All-Seer of the (His) slaves
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: قالوا يذا ٱلقرنين ان ياجوج وماجوج مفسدون في ٱلارض فهل نجعل لك خرجا على ان تجعل بيننا وبينهم سد ا
tgt: They said: "O Dhul-Qarnain! Verily! Ya'juj and Ma'juj (Gog and Magog) are doing great mischief in the land. Shall we then pay you a tribute in order that you might erect a barrier between us and them
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: اذ رءا نار ا فقال لاهله ٱمكثوا اني ءانست نار ا لعلي ءاتيكم منها بقبس او اجد على ٱلنار هد ى
tgt: When he saw a fire, he said to his family: "Wait! Verily, I have seen a fire, perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وتبارك ٱلذي له ملك ٱلسموت وٱلارض وما بينهما وعنده علم ٱلساعة واليه ترجعون
tgt: And blessed be He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, and with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Whom you (all) will be returned
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: واخونهم يمدونهم في ٱلغي ثم لا يقصرون
tgt: But (as for) their brothers (the devils) they (i.e. the devils) plunge them deeper into error, and they never stop short
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: قال ما مكني فيه ربي خير فاعينوني بقوة اجعل بينكم وبينهم ردما
tgt: He said: "That (wealth, authority and power) in which my Lord had established me is better (than your tribute). So help me with strength (of men), I will erect between you and them a barrier
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وما ينبغي لهم وما يستطيعون
tgt: Neither would it suit them, nor they can (produce it)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: واذا بلغ ٱلاطفل منكم ٱلحلم فليستذنوا كما ٱستذن ٱلذين من قبلهم كذلك يبين ٱلله لكم ءايته وٱلله عليم حكيم‏
tgt: And when the children among you come to puberty, then let them (also) ask for permission, as those senior to them (in age). Thus Allah makes clear His Ayat (Commandments and legal obligations) for you. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: فلما جاء ءال لوط ٱلمرسلون
tgt: Then, when the Messengers (the angels) came unto the family of Lout (Lot)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: قالت انى يكون لي غلم ولم يمسسني بشر ولم اك بغي ا
tgt: She said: "How can I have a son, when no man has touched me, nor am I unchaste
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: قالوا بل وجدنا ءاباءنا كذلك يفعلون
tgt: They said: "Nay, but we found our fathers doing so
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: لاخذنا منه بٱليمين
tgt: We surely should have seized him by his right hand (or with power and might)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: يايها ٱلذين ءامنوا ٱجتنبوا كثير ا من ٱلظن ان بعض ٱلظن اثم ولا تجسسوا ولا يغتب بعضكم بعضا ايحب احدكم ان ياكل لحم اخيه ميت ا فكرهتموه وٱتقوا ٱلله ان ٱلله تواب رحيم‏
tgt: O you who believe! Avoid much suspicions, indeed some suspicions are sins. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would hate it (so hate backbiting). And fear Allah. Verily, Allah is the One Who accepts repentance, Most Merciful
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: قل للمومنين يغضوا من ابصرهم ويحفظوا فروجهم ذلك ازكى لهم ان ٱلله خبير بما يصنعون
tgt: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze (from looking at forbidden things), and protect their private parts (from illegal sexual acts, etc.). That is purer for them. Verily, Allah is All-Aware of what they do
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: واذ جعلنا ٱلبيت مثابة للناس وامن ا وٱتخذوا من مقام ابرهم مصل ى وعهدنا الى ابرهم واسمعيل ان طهرا بيتي للطايفين وٱلعكفين وٱلركع ٱلسجود
tgt: And (remember) when We made the House (the Ka'bah at Makkah) a place of resort for mankind and a place of safety. And take you (people) the Maqam (place) of Ibrahim (Abraham) [or the stone on which Ibrahim (Abraham) stood while he was building the Ka'bah] as a place of prayer (for some of your prayers, e.g. two Rak'at after the Tawaf of the Ka'bah at Makkah), and We commanded Ibrahim (Abraham) and Isma'il (Ishmael) that they should purify My House (the Ka'bah at Makkah) for those who are circumambulating it, or staying (I'tikaf), or bowing or prostrating themselves (there, in prayer)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وجوه يوميذ ناضرة

license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: يصلونها يوم ٱلدين

license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: ومنهم ٱلذين يوذون ٱلنبي ويقولون هو اذن قل اذن خير لكم يومن بٱلله ويومن للمومنين ورحمة للذين ءامنوا منكم وٱلذين يوذون رسول ٱلله لهم عذاب اليم‏
tgt: And among them are men who hurt the Prophet (Muhammad SAW) and say: "He is (lending his) ear (to every news)." Say: "He listens to what is best for you; he believes in Allah; has faith in the believers; and is a mercy to those of you who believe." But those who hurt Allah's Messenger (Muhammad SAW) will have a painful torment
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وان اردتم ٱستبدال زوج مكان زوج وءاتيتم احدىهن قنطار ا فلا تاخذوا منه شيا اتاخذونه بهتن ا واثم ا مبين ا
tgt: But if you intend to replace a wife by another and you have given one of them a Cantar (of gold i.e. a great amount) as Mahr, take not the least bit of it back; would you take it wrongfully without a right and (with) a manifest sin
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: قالوا يابانا ما لك لا تامنا على يوسف وانا له لنصحون
tgt: They said: "O our father! Why do you not trust us with Yusuf (Joseph), - when we are indeed his well-wishers

ar: الم نجعل له عينين
tgt: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes

ar: قال لو ان لي بكم قوة او ءاوي الى ركن شديد‏
tgt: He said: "Would that I had strength (men) to overpower you, or that I could betake myself to some powerful support (to resist you)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

tgt: And I swear by the self-reproaching person (a believer)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وجدتها وقومها يسجدون للشمس من دون ٱلله وزين لهم ٱلشيطن اعملهم فصدهم عن ٱلسبيل فهم لا يهتدون
tgt: I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah, and Shaitan (Satan) has made their deeds fair-seeming to them, and has barred them from (Allah's) Way, so they have no guidance
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: فاذا نفخ في ٱلصور فلا انساب بينهم يوميذ ولا يتساءلون
tgt: Then, when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask of one another
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: فورب ٱلسماء وٱلارض انه لحق مثل ما انكم تنطقون
tgt: Then, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth (i.e. what has been promised to you), just as it is the truth that you can speak
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

tgt: Have you (O Muhammad SAW) seen him who has taken as his ilah (god) his own desire? Would you then be a Wakil (a disposer of his affairs or a watcher) over him
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: ذي قوة عند ذي ٱلعرش مكين‏
tgt: Owner of power, and high rank with (Allah) the Lord of the Throne
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

tgt: In houses (mosques), which Allah has ordered to be raised (to be cleaned, and to be honoured), in them His Name is glorified in the mornings and in the afternoons or the evenings
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وهم يصطرخون فيها ربنا اخرجنا نعمل صلحا غير ٱلذي كنا نعمل اولم نعمركم ما يتذكر فيه من تذكر وجاءكم ٱلنذير فذوقوا فما للظلمين من نصير
tgt: Therein they will cry: "Our Lord! Bring us out, we shall do righteous good deeds, not (the evil deeds) that we used to do." (Allah will reply): "Did We not give you lives long enough, so that whosoever would receive admonition, - could receive it? And the warner came to you. So taste you (the evil of your deeds). For the Zalimun (polytheists and wrongdoers, etc.) there is no helper
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: فٱنقلبوا بنعمة من ٱلله وفضل لم يمسسهم سوء وٱتبعوا رضون ٱلله وٱلله ذو فضل عظيم
tgt: So they returned with Grace and Bounty from Allah. No harm touched them; and they followed the good Pleasure of Allah. And Allah is the Owner of Great Bounty
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

tgt: Those who answered (the Call of) Allah and the Messenger (Muhammad SAW) after being wounded; for those of them who did good deeds and feared Allah, there is a great reward
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

tgt: Say (to them): "Verily, the death from which you flee will surely meet you, then you will be sent back to (Allah), the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen, and He will tell you what you used to do
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: ٱلتي تطلع على ٱلافدة

tgt: If you invoke (or call upon) them, they hear not your call, and if (in case) they were to hear, they could not grant it (your request) to you.
